skill.name: email-marketing-bible
skill.description: A data-backed email marketing reference for AI assistants that audits email programs, drafts copy, designs automation flows, benchmarks performance, diagnoses deliverability, and compares platforms.
skill.summary: Data-backed email marketing guidance for audits, automation flows, copy, deliverability, benchmarks, compliance, and platform selection.
skill.author: CosmoBlk

security_audit.summary: Static indicators were caused by Markdown references, inline DNS examples, or the documented Claude installation path. I found no prompt injection or executable behavior, but the cold email section could enable unsolicited outreach if used without consent controls.

remediation.issue: Cold email guidance can be used for unsolicited outreach.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit consent, suppression, rate-limit, and lawful-basis checks before cold outreach or domain-warming advice.

static_findings.snippet: - Dark mode (33%+): Transparent PNGs, off-white backgrounds, `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)`.
- **SPF:** DNS TXT record listing authorised sending IPs. 10 DNS lookup limit. End with `-all`.
- **DKIM:** 2048-bit RSA keys. Rotate annually. `d=` domain must align with From address.
- Interest-based CTAs: 2-3x more replies than meeting requests.
- ROI: $36 per $1 spent (3,600%). Newsletter-as-business: 122%. Social: 28%. Paid search: 25%.
- **Newsletter/Creator:** Inflection at 10K subs. Revenue stack: sponsorships → paid → affiliates →

semantic_findings.title: Cold Email Abuse Enablement
semantic_findings.description: The skill gives operational cold email guidance, including separate domains, per-inbox daily limits, personalization scale, and follow-up cadence. This can support legitimate B2B outreach, but it can also enable unsolicited bulk email if used without consent controls.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cold email instructions are explicit and operational, while nearby compliance guidance reduces but does not remove abuse risk.

content.user_title: Improve Email Marketing with Data-Backed Guidance
content.value_statement: Email teams waste time sorting generic advice from useful tactics. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code data-backed guidance for campaigns, flows, deliverability, and benchmarks.
actual_capabilities: Audit email programs across flows, segmentation, deliverability, compliance, analytics, and platform fit.
Draft subject lines, preview text, body copy, and calls to action using named copywriting frameworks.
Design welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, sunset, nurture, and cold outreach sequences.
Provide industry benchmarks for open rates, click rates, unsubscribe rates, revenue, and frequency.
Compare email platforms by use case, list size, budget, and core strength.
Diagnose deliverability issues with authentication, reputation, bounce, content, and warming checks.
limitations: Does not connect to ESPs, CRMs, or analytics tools without user-provided data.
Benchmarks may change and should be validated against current platform data.
Compliance guidance is informational and does not replace legal advice.
Cold outreach guidance requires consent, suppression, and jurisdiction checks.

use_cases.title: Ecommerce Flow Audit
use_cases.description: A DTC marketer can review current Klaviyo flows and identify revenue gaps, timing problems, and missing segments.

use_cases.title: Deliverability Recovery
use_cases.description: A lifecycle team can diagnose falling inbox placement using authentication, reputation, bounce, content, and warming checks.

use_cases.title: Platform Selection
use_cases.description: A founder can compare email platforms by list size, budget, automation needs, and growth plans.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my current email setup. I use [platform] for [business type], have [flows], and send [frequency]. List the biggest gaps first.

prompt_templates.title: Write A Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [flow type] sequence for [product]. Include timing, goal, subject lines, preview text, email body outline, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Deliverability
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose my deliverability issue. My domain is [age], volume is [volume], bounce rate is [rate], complaints are [rate], and authentication is [status].

prompt_templates.title: Build A Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 90-day email strategy for [business]. Include segments, automations, testing roadmap, reporting cadence, compliance checks, and platform recommendations.

output_examples.input: A Shopify skincare brand has welcome and cart flows but low repeat purchase.
output: A prioritized audit that flags missing post-purchase, replenishment, and win-back flows.
Recommended timing, triggers, exclusions, and metrics for each flow.
Benchmarks for revenue per recipient, click rate, and unsubscribe rate.

output_examples.input: Open rates dropped after volume doubled in Gmail.
output: A deliverability diagnosis covering SPF, DKIM, DMARC, reputation, bounces, content, and sending patterns.
A recovery plan that starts with engaged subscribers and monitors progress over several weeks.

output_examples.input: A SaaS founder needs a launch email plan.
output_examples.output: A segmented onboarding and lifecycle plan with prompts, success metrics, and platform-fit notes.

best_practices: Provide business model, list size, platform, send volume, current flows, and recent performance metrics.
Ask for prioritized recommendations when time, budget, or engineering resources are limited.
Validate legal and deliverability advice against your market, platform rules, and mailbox provider requirements.
anti_patterns: Do not request generic campaigns without audience, offer, lifecycle stage, and success metric.
Do not treat open rate as the only success metric after Apple Mail Privacy Protection.
Do not use cold outreach guidance without consent, suppression lists, and jurisdiction checks.

faq.question: Can this skill send emails?
faq.answer: No. It provides strategy, copy, diagnostics, and plans. It does not connect to an ESP or send messages.

faq.question: Which platforms does it cover?
faq.answer: It discusses platforms such as Klaviyo, Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Kit, Brevo, beehiiv, Omnisend, SmartrMail, Bento, and Postmark.

faq.question: Can it help with deliverability?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers SPF, DKIM, DMARC, reputation, bounce logs, content checks, warming, and recovery monitoring.

faq.question: Does it include compliance advice?
faq.answer: Yes. It summarizes GDPR, CAN-SPAM, CASL, CCPA, and Australian Spam Act topics, but it is not legal advice.

faq.question: Can it write email copy?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft subject lines, preview text, body copy, and calls to action using frameworks such as PAS, AIDA, and BAB.

faq.question: Who should use it?
faq.answer: It is useful for marketers, founders, lifecycle teams, consultants, and operators who manage email strategy or performance.
